es.titular: La región sube con Wall Street; el COLCAP cae 1.4% y el peso colombiano se fortalece
esencial: A las 11:27 CDMX el Ibovespa subía 0.66% (172,461) y el S&P/TSX 0.82%.
El iCOLCAP de Colombia perdía 1.35%, mientras el peso colombiano ganaba 0.33% (3,280 por dólar).
Con el cobre +1.0% y el diésel +2.5%, cotiza hoy insumos de cobre y revisa los recargos de flete regionales.

bloques.x: En la apertura el Ibovespa subía 0.78% y el real se fortalecía a 5.55; Colombia era la excepción a la baja.

A las 11:27 CDMX el Ibovespa estaba en 172,460.55 (+0.66%) y a las 11:42 el S&P/TSX en 36,468 (+0.82%). El ETF de MSCI de Perú subía 0.72% y el de Argentina 0.39%; el de Chile no cambiaba y el iCOLCAP bajaba 1.35%. El real estaba en 5.56 por dólar (dólar −0.30%), el peso colombiano en 3,280 (−0.33%), el peso chileno en 983.8, el sol en 3.41 y el peso argentino en 1,546.5.
La caída de la bolsa de Colombia mientras su moneda se fortalece. El cobre amplió su alza a 1.0% (6.30 dólares por libra), lo que favorece a Perú.

es.scm: Cotiza hoy cable e insumos de cobre, y pide recargos de flete regionales calculados con el diésel, que sube 2.5%.

en.titular: The region rises with Wall Street; the COLCAP falls 1.4% and the Colombian peso strengthens
esencial: At 11:27 a.m. Mexico City time the Ibovespa was up 0.66% (172,461) and the S&P/TSX 0.82%.
Colombia's iCOLCAP was down 1.35%, while the Colombian peso gained 0.33% (3,280 per dollar).
With copper +1.0% and diesel +2.5%, quote copper inputs today and review regional freight surcharges.

bloques.x: At the open the Ibovespa was up 0.78% and the real strengthened to 5.55; Colombia was the exception to the downside.

At 11:27 a.m. Mexico City time the Ibovespa stood at 172,460.55 (+0.66%) and at 11:42 the S&P/TSX at 36,468 (+0.82%). The MSCI Peru ETF was up 0.72% and Argentina's 0.39%; Chile's was flat and the iCOLCAP fell 1.35%. The real was at 5.56 per dollar (dollar −0.30%), the Colombian peso at 3,280 (−0.33%), the Chilean peso at 983.8, the sol at 3.41 and the Argentine peso at 1,546.5.
Colombia's stock market fell while its currency strengthened. Copper extended its gain to 1.0% ($6.30 per pound), helping Peru.

en.scm: Quote cable and copper inputs today, and ask for regional freight surcharges based on diesel, which is up 2.5%.

pt.titular: A região sobe com Wall Street; o COLCAP cai 1,4% e o peso colombiano se fortalece

bloques.x: Na abertura o Ibovespa subia 0,78% e o real se fortalecia para R$ 5,55; a Colômbia era a exceção em queda.

Às 11h27 (Cidade do México) o Ibovespa estava em 172.460,55 (+0,66%) e às 11h42 o S&P/TSX em 36.468 (+0,82%). O dólar estava em R$ 5,56 (dólar −0,30%), o peso colombiano em 3.280 (−0,33%), o peso chileno em 983,8, o sol em 3,41 e o peso argentino em 1.546,5.
A queda da bolsa da Colômbia enquanto sua moeda se fortalece. O cobre ampliou a alta para 1,0% (6,30 dólares por libra), o que favorece o Peru.
